title: Add Binary
summary: Provide the sum of two binary strings as a binary string.
statement: Provide the sum of two binary strings as a binary string.
constraints: There are no leading zeros except for the string 0.
hints: Binary column addition has a carry just like decimal addition.
Read both strings from the right, treating a missing digit as zero.
Add the two bits and carry, append sum modulo two, and carry sum divided by two. Continue while any input or carry remains.
Reverse the collected least-significant-first output bits at the end.
editorial: Maintain one pointer per string and a carry. At each bit position, add present digits to the carry, append the remainder modulo two, and retain the quotient for the next position. The loop must include the final carry after both inputs finish. Reversing the accumulated bits produces the usual most-significant-first result.

tests.explanation: Binary 11 is three and 1 is one. Their sum four is binary 100.
Ten plus eleven is twenty-one, represented by 10101.
